description: A shell script for testing Git's commit-graph functionality, including setup, verification, error handling, and various test scenarios for commit-graph integrity and behavior.

methods.name: corrupt_graph_setup
methods.description: Prepares the commit-graph file for corruption tests by backing it up and making it writable.

methods.name: corrupt_graph_verify
methods.description: Runs 'git commit-graph verify' expecting failure with specific error string, optionally copying the graph file for further tests.

methods.name: corrupt_graph_and_verify
methods.description: Corrupts the commit-graph file at a specified position with given data, then runs verification expecting a specific error message.

methods.name: corrupt_chunk
methods.description: Sets up commit-graph and corrupts a specific chunk in the file.

methods.name: check_corrupt_chunk
methods.description: Corrupts a chunk and verifies that the error output matches expectations.
